issue.title: decision-card Keep test sees the review-journal missing-API notice instead of the Keep notice

task_type_fields.node_id: scripts/test-navigation-decision-card-handlers.cjs::Keep counts once and saturates at 999 without reset
task_type_fields.why_not_flake: Reproduces identically at the pre-epic base 4193a19 and at master 1abde2f (bob-plugins). The test is `Keep counts once and saturates at 999 without reset` (scripts/test-navigation-decision-card-handlers.cjs:546). The keep write itself succeeds: the line gains `[keeps:: 4]` and the new fresh date. But the last notice is "Update Bob Ledger Tools to record review stats" (nav 545-plugin-review-journal.js:220 `noticeReviewJournalMissingApi`) instead of /Kept \d+× · next review asks/. Likely cause: the test's `freshnessCapable` stub lacks the ledger review-journal API that the Keep handler now calls after the keep notice. So the missing-API notice fires last. Fix the stub, or assert on the Keep notice rather than the last one. Confirm the review-journal call order first.

issue.creation_reason: Proposed by bob-cli-6u.12 (note #5) and bob-cli-6u.13/6u.14 as a clean-base bob-plugins failure; bob-cli-6u.land confirmed it predates the epic and no bead tracked it.
